resume_instruction: Owner rebuild/restart. V3 org state migrates to v4 without trusting old negative echoes. A qualifying ~4.9KB confirmation near a 5200 budget should mark 5200 proven-safe and advance current to about 5700; another qualifying frontier success can advance to about 6250. A 644B self-echo miss below larger confirmed evidence logs uncertainty only and must not retry. An unproven larger frontier miss records failed budget, narrows between safe/fail, rebuilds/retries after 3s; late exact echo still cancels queued retry. #status shows current(default), proven safe, failed probe, max-confirmed, last-unconfirmed and retries.
